gates.buildReason: Direct HTML/JavaScript application; no build step is required.

realEdge.environment: GitHub Actions windows-latest with Microsoft Edge, real index.html iframe integration, 390px/320px mobile checks, partial API failure simulation, empty-state fixtures, long-name fixtures, and EOD failure retry simulation
coverage: analysis main/sub tabs retain usable touch targets and one-row layout on 390px and 320px widths
long machine/product names wrap safely without horizontal overflow
partial API failures preserve healthy analysis panels and show a retryable warning
sales, inventory, and efficiency empty states remain explicit and non-destructive
end-of-day loading failure shows an inline retry path
analysis UI remains read-only and does not mutate legacy localStorage state
